title_en: Winter Session 2026: Applications for the Field Practice Semester Course 'Field Practice 3'
summary: Students of the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering who are interested in the 2026 Winter Session field practice semester course 'Field Practice 3' may apply by emailing a signed application form to the department office. The first application period is 26–30 October 2026, and a second period of 10–11 November 2026 may be held depending on first-round results. Selected students must also register for the course and must not take any other Winter Session course.
applies_to: Interested students who wish to take the 2026 Winter Session field practice semester course 'Field Practice 3' (현장실습 3), announced by the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering. Application is voluntary; the notice states no further eligibility limits in its text (the course overview and host organisation details are in sections and attachments that were not read).

dates.when: Monday 26 October 2026 to Friday 30 October 2026 (deadline strictly observed)

dates.what: Second-round application period (may not be held, depending on first-round selection results)
dates.when: Tuesday 10 November 2026 to Wednesday 11 November 2026 (deadline strictly observed)

conditions: Selected students must complete course registration for 'Field Practice 3', because the field practice and the course run together.
Students taking 'Field Practice 3' may not take any other Winter Session course, including online (remote) courses.
Any other Winter Session course a student has already registered for will be cancelled.
Course registration and tuition payment dates may differ from the regular schedule; students must check the separate notice.
Students who withdraw from the field practice midway or participate insincerely will not receive credit, and payment of the practice allowance may be restricted.
The second-round application may not be held, depending on the results of the first-round selection.
The application form must include the student's signature at the bottom.
steps: Read the list of host organisations in attachment [붙임1] (2026(동계) 현장실습학기제_현장실습3_실습기관.xlsx); the table in the notice body and the course overview and schedule sections were not available in the text and were not read.
If applying to Hanwha Ocean, read attachment [붙임3] (description of duties by job role) to help complete the desired job field on the form.
Download the application form for your chosen host: [붙임2-1] Hanwha Ocean (한화오션), [붙임2-2] Samsung Heavy Industries (삼성중공업), or [붙임2-3] Korean Register (한국선급).
Complete the form and sign it at the bottom.
Submit the form by email to the department office of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering (Building 34, Room 417) within the application period; the email address is given in the original notice.
If selected, check the separate notice for the course registration and tuition payment schedule, then register for 'Field Practice 3' and pay tuition as instructed.
translation:
Application for Field Practice in the 2026 Winter Session Field Practice Semester Course 'Field Practice 3' (현장실습 3)

We announce the application for field practice in the 2026 Winter Session field practice semester course 'Field Practice 3' as follows. Interested students are encouraged to apply.

Because 'Field Practice 3' combines field practice with taking the course, students must complete course registration (수강신청), and they may not take any other Winter Session course (including online courses). Any other course already registered for will be cancelled. The course registration and tuition payment schedules may differ from the regular schedule, so students must check the separate notice.

Please note that if a student withdraws from the field practice midway or participates insincerely, no credit will be awarded and payment of the practice allowance may be restricted.

3. Host organisations (※ If the table below is not visible, refer to the file "[붙임1]") [table not included in the text; not read]

4. How to submit the application: by email (including the signature at the bottom of the application form)

5. Application period (deadlines strictly observed)
 - (1st round) Monday 26 October 2026 – Friday 30 October 2026
 - (2nd round) Tuesday 10 November 2026 – Wednesday 11 November 2026 (※ Depending on the results of the first-round selection, the second-round selection may not be held.)

6. Submission and enquiries: Department office of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering (Building 34, Room 417). The contact person, email address and phone number are given in the original notice.
